name: Rachel Barlow
headline_caption: Installation view, What’s Lost in the Dance, Kutlesa, Switzerland, 2026
about:
Rachel Barlow is an artist from Cambridge, now living and working in London. Her paintings use landscape to explore memory, feeling and belonging, drawing on southern Siberia, where her family is from.

She often starts from real places affected by human destruction or natural disaster, and reworks them into something part real, part imagined. With a background in English literature, she thinks of abstraction as a kind of language.
